Delta_Trigram.source: research features.csv (92,299 HDTB pairs), rescored with the Katz-backoff trigram

Delta_AdaptiveWiki50M.source: Wiki-50M LSTM rebuild, scored on the research features.csv (92,299 HDTB pairs); same Joachims + univariate fit as the other entries

meta.method: abs(standardized univariate logistic coefficient), Joachims pairwise transform, C=1e6

provenance.others: Ranjan & van Schijndel research features.csv (hi_hdtb-ud-train.conllu, SOV+DOSV+IOSV, 92,299 pairs)
provenance.Delta_Trigram: refit 2026-08-29 when the trigram scorer became the Katz-backoff model; same 92,299 pairs, 77.09% -> 89.52%. Most of the gain is the scoring function (<s> <s> padding + training-time normalisation), not the model.
provenance.Delta_AdaptiveWiki50M: fitted on the same 92,299 pairs. Model: 2-layer LSTM retrained on 50.8M tokens of Hindi Wikipedia (held-out perplexity 79.65), scored with <SOS>/<EOS> framing and training-time normalisation. Training stopped on a 25-minute budget, not convergence.
